summary: Implemented deterministic offline PMBOT dossier human-review pack export. The exporter reads only the local RESEARCH-013 validation result, dossier skeletons, merged manual research packets, and operator review records result; exports only draft_ready_for_human_review accepted draft records; emits JSON, Markdown, and expected JSON artifacts for market_id 563650; and creates no completed dossiers, recommendations, scores, probabilities, EV calculations, side decisions, paper orders, runtime wiring, or live actions.

tests_run.command: python -c "import json, pathlib; paths=['pm_bot/research/dossier_human_review_pack.v1.json','pm_bot/research/expected_dossier_human_review_pack.v1.json','docs/PMBOT_RESEARCH_014_RESULT.json']; [json.load(open(pathlib.Path(p), encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]; print('parsed', len(paths), 'json artifacts')"
